wins: Maintained stability throughout episode with consistent reward extraction despite no success
Effective handling of initial reconnaissance with accurate scanning data collection
fails: Failed to achieve mission success after 10 mentor escalations due to incomplete exploitation chain
Critical credential capture step was missed, preventing privilege escalation and actionable access
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase performed reliably but exploitation and post-exploitation steps were not completed, leading to zero success despite high engagement.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to pivot from reconnaissance to exploitation because credential harvesting was skipped

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap version scan with ssh‑related scripts to enumerate host keys and supported ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service is reachable and returns status 200
skill_cards.then_action: Spider the web root with dirb and capture reachable endpoints for potential input vectors

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials are captured or default passwords confirmed
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential-based SSH or HTTP login using Hydra or Burp Intruder with captured creds

memory_ops.reason: Consistent reliability in SSH reconnaissance narrows the attack surface effectively
Web enumeration consistently identifies additional service panels for follow-up
